photos.title: Myrtle Beach (24050832475)
photos.what: The beach in downtown Myrtle Beach at low tide, seen from a pier: the SkyWheel, rows of blue beach umbrellas, palms and low buildings behind the dunes, a tall hotel or condo tower on the right and more towers along the shore to the north. People on the sand are small; none is the subject and no face can be recognized.
photos.caption: The beach beside the SkyWheel in downtown Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: The wide beach in downtown Myrtle Beach at low tide, with the SkyWheel, rows of blue umbrellas and towers along the shore

place.sublocation: Downtown Myrtle Beach, the beach beside the SkyWheel and the boardwalk

photos.title: Houses around ponds in Carolina Forest, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Rows of one- and two-story houses with gray roofs, short driveways and fenced back yards along curving streets, around two ponds with fountains, with a shared pool, playground and parking lot at the bottom and pine woods at the lower right, in Carolina Forest outside city limits, seen from above on January 12, 2026. Lawns are brown in January. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses around ponds in Carolina Forest, outside city limits, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of houses with gray roofs along curving streets around two ponds with fountains, with a shared pool and pine woods at the bottom, seen from above
